name: qlrisk_sensitivities
title: Sensitivities and Greeks
description: Bump-and-reprice risk: DV01, CS01, DIV01, delta, vega, gamma, theta, key-rate ladders (native or FRTB vertices), cross-gamma; by risk class, trade and factor. Trades take the inputs of the qlrisk_price_<product> tools. Example: {"trades": [{"product": "InterestRateSwap", "trade_id": "IRS-5Y", "maturity": "5Y", "notional": 10000000, "fixed_rate_pct": 4.4, "counterparty_id": "BANK-A"}], "ladder_vertices": "frtb_girr"} gives Sensitivities in USD for 1 trade(s): DV01 4,561.84 on qlrisk's sample market valued 2026-10-09.
